slides.title: It's metal now
slides.body: Our engineers used aircraft-grade aluminium to build the unibody on Phone (4a) Pro, bringing a future-forward, metallic flicker into our distinct mechanical design. Cold to the touch, the metal unibody is designed to dissipate heat with remarkable speed.

slides.title: Make room for colour
slides.body: Phone (4a) Pro debuts in three striking metallic finishes – Silver, Black and Pink, where precision engineering meets sophisticated and refined style for a premium look.

slides.title: Slimmest Nothing Phone
slides.body: Elite engineering delivers the slimmest metal unibody phone on the market³ at just 7.95 mm, and built for a premium in-hand feel with 42% improved* bend resistance. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: Keep cool
slides.body: The aluminium unibody acts as a unified cooling unit. Paired with our 5,300 mm² large vapour cooling system, Phone (4a) Pro features an 82% increase* in total cooling area compared to previous generations. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: See inside
slides.body: Our signature transparent design appears in the most functional area – the camera bump. Using nano-level injection moulding, the 3D enclosure is integrated into the main aluminium unibody, exposing hints of the mechanical structures beneath.

slides.title: Built to last
slides.body: Ready for anything. Phone (4a) Pro is rated IP65 for dust and water resistance and has been tested under 25 cm of water for up to 20 minutes. Plus, the screen is equipped with Corning® Gorilla® Glass 7i, delivering up to twice the scratch resistance compared to earlier generations.¹⁰

slides.title: Capture pro-level details
slides.body: A pro 3-camera system, from 0.6x ultra-wide to 140x ultra zoom, powered by a flagship 50 MP OIS Sony main camera, lets you capture every detail. Near or far, day or night.

slides.title: World’s first 140x ultra zoom
slides.body: Phone (4a) Pro is equipped with a 50 MP OIS periscope camera with up to 140x ultra zoom⁴, making it the most powerful phone zoom on the market.

slides.title: Tetraprism periscope zoom
slides.body: Phone (4a) Pro’s periscope camera features an advanced tetraprism system that delivers 3.5x optical zoom with zero light loss, using a three-mirror, W-shaped light path to preserve image detail while reducing the camera bump by 32%*. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro

slides.title: Superior shots by Sony camera
slides.body: Take stunning night shots and freeze fast-moving action effortlessly with the class-leading 50 MP Sony main camera with OIS and up to 1 second faster shutter speed*. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: No more selfie sticks
slides.body: The super-wide 32 MP front camera is designed to capture larger groups. A new 89° wide-angle lens offers 10% wider coverage than Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: True-to-life details
slides.body: Phone (4a) Pro is powered by TrueLens Engine 4, advanced multi-frame RAW processing and 12-layer AI segmentation for Ultra XDR photos, Motion Photos, portraits and lifelike details.

slides.title: Ultra XDR photo
slides.body: Capture 13 RAW frames at varying exposures and merge them to reveal true-to-life detail, with every pixel’s brightness boosted up to 12 times on screen, ready to share on Instagram.

slides.title: Ultra XDR photo
slides.body: Capture 13 RAW frames at varying exposures and merge them to reveal true-to-life detail, with every pixel’s brightness boosted up to 12 times on screen, ready to share on Instagram.

slides.title: Ultra XDR photos that move
slides.body: Tap the shutter to capture up to 3 seconds of sound, colour and movement in a single photo. Plus, Phone (4a) Pro captures around 90 frames for you to choose from.

slides.title: Create in 4K Ultra XDR video
slides.body: Every frame, every detail captured in striking clarity with 4K Ultra XDR video, delivering exceptional video quality in any lighting.

slides.title: Accurate colour
slides.body: AI analyses each scene across up to 12 pixel-level layers to optimise subject and background, delivering accurate colour and a natural balance between foreground and background.

slides.title: Accurate colour
slides.body: AI analyses each scene across up to 12 pixel-level layers to optimise subject and background, delivering accurate colour and a natural balance between foreground and background.

slides.title: Pro-level portraits
slides.body: AI subject segmentation identifies elements within a portrait, from clothing to skin and fine details like hair to create natural bokeh, accurate skin tones and stunning photos.

slides.title: Pro-level portraits
slides.body: AI subject segmentation identifies elements within a portrait, from clothing to skin and fine details like hair to create natural bokeh, accurate skin tones and stunning photos.

slides.title: Make every shot cinematic
slides.body: Fine-tune up to 7 camera settings like a pro, shoot in RAW for maximum editing control or apply ready-made presets created by Nothing Community photographers.

slides.title: No more bad photos
slides.body: New to the Nothing Gallery app, AI Eraser instantly removes unwanted objects, people, and reflections with a single tap*. It runs fully on-device, so your photos never leave your phone. *Circle to Erase coming soon.

slides.title: Are we live?
slides.body: Inspired by traditional film cameras, a custom red recording light flicks on when you’re shooting video on Phone (4a) Pro, so it’s always clear when recording is active.

slides.title: Flagship grade Glyph Matrix
slides.body: Put your screen down and reduce distractions. The Glyph Matrix highlights important alerts at a glance, plus handy tools like a timer, selfie mirror and more.

slides.title: Essential Notifications
slides.body: Signals only you understand. Assign discreet icons to specific contacts or keywords in Essential Notifications, so important notifications stand out – clearly for you, quietly for everyone else.

slides.title: Glyph Matrix progress tracker
slides.body: Progress-based notifications now appear on the Glyph Matrix, synced with your screen. Track rides, deliveries, and timers with intuitive lights and motion cues at a glance. Supported apps include Uber, Google Calendar, Zomato, Just Eat, and Google Maps, with more integrations coming soon¹⁴.

slides.title: Handy tools
slides.body: Glyph Matrix displays key information like a digital clock, battery status, and solar path, doubling as an always-on Glyph Toy, while also offering practical tools such as a timer, camera countdown, and selfie mirror.

slides.title: Light work
slides.body: Made with 137 precision mini-LEDs, the Glyph Matrix is 57% larger and twice as bright*. *Compared to Phone (3)

slides.title: Life runs easier on Nothing OS
slides.body: A calmer, personalised and intentional experience with smart tools to keep you focused. Built on Android 16 with 3 years of OS updates and 6 years of security updates.

slides.title: Unified simplicity
slides.body: Unified hardware and software design, unique to Nothing, across icons and layouts to improve clarity, speed and focus.

slides.title: Personal by design
slides.body: Customise your home and lock screens with widgets that matter, flexible layouts and new depth-effect wallpapers that adapt around your subject.

slides.title: Fast and smooth
slides.body: Animations feel smoother and more natural than ever when opening, closing or switching apps, and when scrolling through photos, reducing stutter and lag.

slides.title: Live updates with Glyph Matrix
slides.body: Real time updates stay visible across the Always-on Display, Status Bar, Lock Screen and Notifications, so you can stay aware without opening apps. When your phone is on the table or nearby, progress shows through the Glyph Matrix, making it easy to follow rides, deliveries or timers at a glance. Supports Uber, Google Calendar, Zomato, Just Eat and Google Maps. More integrations coming soon¹⁴.

slides.title: Built-in Google Gemini
slides.body: Meet Gemini, your personal AI assistant from Google, designed to fuel your creativity and get things done. Whether it’s writing, planning or learning, Gemini is here to make your ideas come to life.

slides.title: ChatGPT integration
slides.body: Get answers, explore ideas and think things through across your Nothing devices. ChatGPT is integrated into Nothing OS and works through widgets, audio and watch interactions, so help is always close without pulling you out of what you’re doing.

slides.title: Nothing OS 4.1 highlights
slides.body: A redesigned lock screen with more clock and widget sizes. Two new Relax widgets help you unwind and stay focused. Plus, the system is now smoother and more responsive than ever.

slides.title: A more personal way to use your phone
slides.body: Essential is a set of AI tools and features within Nothing OS that help you capture, find, remember, and create with less effort. It adapts over time to the way you think and live.

slides.title: Essential Space
slides.body: Essential Space is your second memory. It's a place for you to capture and save what matters. Use the Essential Key to instantly capture an idea, screenshot, photo or voice note. Our powerful AI processing makes sense of it by creating intelligent summaries, extracting key information and to-dos, and even helping you remember upcoming events. You capture. Essential Space takes care of the rest. Essential Space syncs seamlessly across devices. Over time, your Essential Space will be available across your phone, laptop, desktop, and more, so what matters is always within reach.

slides.title: Essential Search
slides.body: Essential Search is Nothing’s own AI-powered search. Instead of giving you a list of links, it delivers concise, to-the-point answers without wasting your time. Look up news, recipes or get translations instantly. Integrated directly into Nothing OS, Essential Search works without opening any apps. Just swipe up on your home screen and start typing in the search bar.

slides.title: Essential Memory
slides.body: Essential Memory helps you recall important information naturally. Memories are created from what you capture in Essential Space, adding personal context to the answers you get from Essential Search.

slides.title: Essential Voice
slides.body: Essential Voice turns your speech into clear, well-structured text. It removes filler words, fixes mistakes and adapts tone for messages, emails or formal writing, while still sounding like you. You can also speak in one language and instantly get text in another. With support for up to 100 languages, communication across countries feels smooth and natural.

slides.title: Essential Apps
slides.body: Essential Apps let you create small, personal tools using simple language. Instead of downloading apps, you shape what you need around your day. These tools live directly on your home screen, stay active, and respond when you need them. They feel less like apps you open and more like tools that are already there, ready to use.

slides.title: A marketplace for personal tools
slides.body: Playground is where Essential Apps live, travel and grow. Browse tools made by the community, download what fits your life or share what you’ve built with others. Alongside Essential Apps, Playground is also home to Glyph Toys, camera presets and EQ profiles. Personal ideas become shared creations, without app stores or barriers.

slides.title: Essential Apps Builder
slides.body: The Essential Apps Builder is how your ideas take form. Describe what you want in plain language and the builder turns it into a working tool. No coding. No setup. You can refine it over time, personalise it with your own visuals and keep it exactly how you like. When you’re ready, share it through Playground or keep it just for yourself.

slides.title: Camera Presets
slides.body: Camera Presets let you discover and share different ways of seeing. Browse presets created by the community and download them directly to your Nothing camera, or upload your own presets you’ve already made to share with others. Each preset reflects a personal shooting style, from colour and contrast to mood and tone, turning photography into something personal, expressive and easy to explore together.

slides.title: Glyph Toys
slides.body: Glyph Toys are small interactive experiences designed for the Glyph Interface. With the Glyph SDK now available publicly, anyone can create and share their own Glyph Toys on Playground or download ones made by others. Explore different light-based interactions to add playful, functional behaviours to your device, turning the Glyph Interface into something more personal and expressive.

slides.title: Our best ever
slides.body: The 1.5K high-resolution flexible AMOLED display, our brightest yet, combined with the largest 6.83-inch screen and slimmest bezels ever, delivers an exceptionally crisp and immersive photo and video viewing experience.

slides.title: Faster
slides.body: Class-leading ultra-smooth 144 Hz adaptive refresh rate for snappy daily interactions. Every swipe, scroll, and slide feels 20% faster and smoother than ever.

slides.title: Brighter
slides.body: The 5,000-nit ultra-bright display is 66% brighter, with 23% better* sunlight visibility; 10-bit colour delivers 1.07 billion vivid tones. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: Eye comfort
slides.body: Our phones use advanced display tech that intelligently reduces flicker – the hidden culprit behind night-time eye strain. The result? Comfortable viewing in any lighting, at any brightness.

slides.title: Pro Snapdragon power
slides.body: Class-leading Snapdragon® 7 Gen 4 delivers top-tier performance with seamless multitasking, AI processing, and ultra-smooth gaming.

slides.title: Built for AI
slides.body: Powered by the advanced Qualcomm AI Engine with up to 65% faster AI processing*, Phone (4a) Pro unlocks smoother AI multitasking, quicker real-time translation, improved camera performance, and more intelligent app experiences. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: Even faster
slides.body: Flagship LPDDR5X memory and advanced UFS 3.1 storage enable faster app launches, smoother multitasking, and seamless handling of heavy workloads¹¹.

slides.title: Pro-level gaming
slides.body: Enjoy ultra-smooth, lag-free 120 FPS gameplay for over 60 minutes, with 2,500 Hz instant touch sampling rate for ultra-responsive, longer, and more stable sessions. The X-axis linear motor adds responsive haptic feedback that brings your games to life⁶.

slides.title: Last longer
slides.body: Charge in minutes, last for days with a 5,080* mAh battery. 20 hours of YouTube. 25 hours of Instagram scrolling. 28 hours of listening to music. 51 hours of voice calls. Maintain over 90% maximum capacity after 1,200 charging cycles. 50W Fast Charge. A day's power in under 30 mins⁷. *5,400 mAh (India only)

slides.title: Crafted with precision
slides.body: Advanced factories combined with professional automated production and assembly techniques ensure meticulous craftsmanship and fine detail. Our biggest step for the environment. Phone (4a) Pro has our lowest ever carbon footprint for a Nothing smartphone at just 50.5 kg CO₂e. It also incorporates 46 components that contain recycled materials, accounting for 16.6% of the total weight. Recycled materials - 100% recycled tin is used in 6 circuit boards. - 80% recycled steel is used for 32 steel parts. - 100% recycled aluminium is used for the back cover. - 30% recycled plastic is used for 6 plastic parts. Packaging - 100% plastic-free Manufacturing - 100% renewable energy for the final assembly process.
